[defaults]
inventory = ./inventory/hosts.yml
roles_path = ./roles
library = ./library
module_utils = ./module_utils
remote_user = svc_ansible
host_key_checking = True
retry_files_enabled = False
interpreter_python = auto_silent
forks = 6
timeout = 10

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077

ticket_id="P1-K8S-01"
repo_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
evidence_root="${GATE0_EVIDENCE_DIR:-${repo_root}/docs/evidence/${ticket_id}}"
action="${1:-}"
timestamp="$(date '+%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%z')"

test "$(hostnamectl --static)" = "ansible01"
test "$(id -un)" = "server01_ansible"
test -n "${ANSIBLE_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE:-}"
test -r "${ANSIBLE_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE}"
mkdir -p "${evidence_root}"

# F07 (권욱님 코드 리뷰, 최소 보완): finalize가 "지금 시점" HEAD만 인덱스에
# 남기면 run(A) 직후 checkout(B) → finalize(B) 순서에서 A의 로그가 B에서
# 검증된 것으로 오인될 수 있다. run/check 실행 시점의 HEAD·종료 코드를
# 로그와 함께 남기고, finalize는 이 값을 그대로 인용한다.
#
# F07 재검토 (권욱님 코드 리뷰):
# 이전 수정은 ansible-playbook | tee 파이프라인의 성공·실패 경로에서
# PIPESTATUS[0]만 참조했다. 그러나 PIPESTATUS[0]은 ansible-playbook의
# 종료 코드만 의미하므로, ansible이 성공했더라도 tee가 실패하면
# exit_code=0으로 잘못 기록될 수 있다.
#
# 따라서 set -e가 파이프라인 실패에서 함수를 즉시 종료시키지 않도록
# 파이프라인을 if 조건 안에서 실행하고, 각 경로에서 PIPESTATUS 배열
# 전체를 즉시 복사한다. 이후 ansible/tee 각각의 종료 코드를 기록하고,
# pipefail과 동일하게 마지막 non-zero 종료 코드를 최종 exit_code로
# 사용한다. (참고: "|| true"로 파이프라인 실패를 무마하는 방식은
# 채택하지 않는다 — true가 실행되는 순간 그 자체가 새 명령이 되어
# PIPESTATUS를 덮어쓸 수 있기 때문이다.)
run_playbook() {
  local label="$1"
  shift
  local exit_code
  local ansible_rc
  local tee_rc
  local run_head_sha
  local -a pipe_status

  run_head_sha="$(git -C "${repo_root}" rev-parse --verify HEAD)"

  if ansible-playbook -i "${repo_root}/inventory/hosts.yml" "$@" \
      2>&1 | tee "${evidence_root}/${timestamp}_${label}.txt"; then
    pipe_status=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
  else
    pipe_status=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
  fi

  ansible_rc="${pipe_status[0]}"
  tee_rc="${pipe_status[1]}"

  # pipefail과 동일하게 마지막 non-zero 종료 코드를 최종 코드로 사용한다.
  if [ "${tee_rc}" -ne 0 ]; then
    exit_code="${tee_rc}"
  else
    exit_code="${ansible_rc}"
  fi

  {
    echo "log_file=${timestamp}_${label}.txt"
    echo "head_sha=${run_head_sha}"
    echo "ansible_exit_code=${ansible_rc}"
    echo "tee_exit_code=${tee_rc}"
    echo "exit_code=${exit_code}"
  } > "${evidence_root}/${timestamp}_${label}.meta"

  return "${exit_code}"
}

case "${action}" in
  syntax)
    ansible-playbook -i "${repo_root}/inventory/hosts.yml" --syntax-check \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/p1-k8s-01-gate0-precheck.yml"
    ;;
  check)
    run_playbook "gate0_check_diff" --check --diff \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/p1-k8s-01-gate0-precheck.yml"
    ;;
  run)
    run_playbook "gate0_precheck" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/p1-k8s-01-gate0-precheck.yml"
    ;;
  finalize)
    finalize_head_sha="$(git -C "${repo_root}" rev-parse --verify HEAD)"
    {
      echo "# ${ticket_id} Gate 0 Evidence Index"
      echo
      echo "- Generated: ${timestamp}"
      echo "- Repository: 321Team/infra-ansible"
      echo "- Finalize HEAD: ${finalize_head_sha}"
      echo "- Working directory: $(pwd)"
      echo
      echo "## Environment (per code review request)"
      echo '```text'
      ansible --version
      echo '```'
      echo
      echo "### ansible-config dump --only-changed"
      echo '```text'
      (cd "${repo_root}" && ansible-config dump --only-changed)
      echo '```'
      echo
      # F07 재검토: *.meta 기준 순회는 실행이 중단되어 .meta가 없는
      # 실패 로그를 인덱스에서 아예 누락시켰다. *.txt 로그를 기준으로
      # 순회하고 대응하는 .meta 존재 여부를 개별 확인해, 실행 정보가
      # 없는 로그도 명시적으로 드러낸다.
      #
      # F07 재재검토 (권욱님 코드 리뷰): source는 새 스코프를 만들지
      # 않으므로, 루프 반복 사이에 이전 .meta에서 설정된
      # head_sha/ansible_exit_code/tee_exit_code/exit_code 변수가
      # 그대로 남아 있었다. 구형 .meta처럼 일부 필드가 없는 파일을
      # source하면 그 필드는 갱신되지 않고 직전 반복의 값을 그대로
      # 재사용해 잘못된 값이 출력됐다. 매 반복 시작 시 이 변수들을
      # 명시적으로 UNKNOWN으로 초기화한 뒤 source하여, 없는 필드는
      # 반드시 UNKNOWN으로 표시되게 한다.
      echo "## Runs (HEAD/exit code as recorded at run/check time, not finalize time)"
      for log_file_path in "${evidence_root}"/*.txt; do
        [ -e "${log_file_path}" ] || continue
        log_name="$(basename "${log_file_path}")"
        meta_file="${log_file_path%.txt}.meta"
        echo
        echo "- Log: \`${log_name}\`"
        if [ -e "${meta_file}" ]; then
          head_sha="UNKNOWN"
          exit_code="UNKNOWN"
          ansible_exit_code="UNKNOWN"
          tee_exit_code="UNKNOWN"
          # shellcheck disable=SC1090
          source "${meta_file}"
          echo "  - Run HEAD: \`${head_sha}\`"
          echo "  - Ansible exit code: ${ansible_exit_code}"
          echo "  - tee exit code: ${tee_exit_code}"
          echo "  - Final exit code: ${exit_code}"
          if [ "${ansible_exit_code}" = "UNKNOWN" ] || [ "${tee_exit_code}" = "UNKNOWN" ]; then
            echo "  - ⚠ INCOMPLETE METADATA: this .meta predates per-command exit code tracking (ansible/tee breakdown unavailable)"
          fi
          if [ "${head_sha}" != "UNKNOWN" ] && [ "${head_sha}" != "${finalize_head_sha}" ]; then
            echo "  - ⚠ WARNING: run HEAD differs from finalize HEAD (${finalize_head_sha})"
          fi
        else
          echo "  - ⚠ NO EXECUTION METADATA: run/check terminated before metadata was recorded (HEAD/exit code unknown)"
        fi
      done
      echo
      echo "## Files"
      find "${evidence_root}" -maxdepth 1 -type f \
        ! -name EVIDENCE_INDEX.md ! -name SHA256SUMS \
        -printf '%f\n' | sort | sed 's/^/- `/' | sed 's/$/`/'
    } > "${evidence_root}/EVIDENCE_INDEX.md"
    (
      cd "${evidence_root}"
      find . -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 \
        | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > SHA256SUMS
      sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS \
        > "${timestamp}_integrity_check.txt"
      find . -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 \
        | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > SHA256SUMS
      sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS
    )
    ;;
  *)
    echo "usage: $0 {syntax|check|run|finalize}" >&2
    exit 64
    ;;
esac

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077

change_id="CR-P1-ANS-01-01"
expected_base="98cf3f826ac0805bcc771ad760a15d931c1bd414"
repo_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
evidence_root="${CR_EVIDENCE_DIR:-${repo_root}/docs/evidence/${change_id}}"
action="${1:-}"
timestamp="$(date '+%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%z')"

test "$(hostnamectl --static)" = "ansible01"
test "$(id -un)" = "server01_ansible"
test -n "${ANSIBLE_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE:-}"
test -r "${ANSIBLE_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE}"
git -C "${repo_root}" merge-base --is-ancestor "${expected_base}" HEAD
mkdir -p "${evidence_root}"

run_playbook() {
  local label="$1"
  shift
  ansible-playbook -i "${repo_root}/inventory/hosts.yml" "$@" \
    2>&1 | tee "${evidence_root}/${timestamp}_${label}.txt"
}

require_change_approval() {
  test "${CR_CHANGE_APPROVED:-}" = "${change_id}"
}

case "${action}" in
  precheck)
    run_playbook "precheck" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-ans-01-01-precheck.yml"
    ;;
  control-plane)
    require_change_approval
    run_playbook "control_plane_check_diff" --check --diff \
      -e "cr_dns_change_approved=${change_id}" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-ans-01-01-apply-control-plane.yml"
    run_playbook "control_plane_apply" \
      -e "cr_dns_change_approved=${change_id}" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-ans-01-01-apply-control-plane.yml"
    run_playbook "control_plane_idempotency" \
      -e "cr_dns_change_approved=${change_id}" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-ans-01-01-apply-control-plane.yml"
    ;;
  workers)
    require_change_approval
    run_playbook "workers_check_diff" --check --diff \
      -e "cr_dns_change_approved=${change_id}" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-ans-01-01-apply-workers.yml"
    run_playbook "workers_apply" \
      -e "cr_dns_change_approved=${change_id}" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-ans-01-01-apply-workers.yml"
    run_playbook "workers_idempotency" \
      -e "cr_dns_change_approved=${change_id}" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-ans-01-01-apply-workers.yml"
    ;;
  verify)
    run_playbook "verify_all_nodes" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-ans-01-01-verify.yml"
    ;;
  rollback)
    require_change_approval
    rollback_host="${2:-}"
    test -n "${rollback_host}"
    run_playbook "rollback_${rollback_host}" \
      -e "cr_dns_rollback_host=${rollback_host}" \
      -e "cr_dns_rollback_approved=${change_id}" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-ans-01-01-rollback.yml"
    ;;
  finalize)
    head_sha="$(git -C "${repo_root}" rev-parse --verify HEAD)"
    {
      echo "# ${change_id} Evidence Index"
      echo
      echo "- Generated: ${timestamp}"
      echo "- Repository: 321Team/infra-ansible"
      echo "- Commit: ${head_sha}"
      echo "- Expected base: ${expected_base}"
      echo
      echo "## Files"
      find "${evidence_root}" -maxdepth 1 -type f \
        ! -name EVIDENCE_INDEX.md ! -name SHA256SUMS \
        -printf '%f\n' | sort | sed 's/^/- `/' | sed 's/$/`/'
    } > "${evidence_root}/EVIDENCE_INDEX.md"
    (
      cd "${evidence_root}"
      find . -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 \
        | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > SHA256SUMS
      sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS \
        > "${timestamp}_integrity_check.txt"
      find . -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 \
        | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > SHA256SUMS
      sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS
    )
    ;;
  *)
    echo "usage: $0 {precheck|control-plane|workers|verify|rollback HOST|finalize}" >&2
    exit 64
    ;;
esac

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077

# Local provenance must not be redirected to a different repository by Git
# environment variables inherited from a controller shell.
for git_env_name in "${!GIT_@}"; do
  unset "${git_env_name}"
done

change_id="CR-P1-NTP-01-01"
repo_root="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd -P)"
test "$(git -C "${repo_root}" rev-parse --show-toplevel)" = "${repo_root}"
# Keep the lock for this complete wrapper action, including restart/verify.
# Rollout children reuse a verified inherited descriptor, never a boolean bypass.
if [[ -z "${CR_NTP_WORKFLOW_LOCK_FD:-}" ]]; then
  exec python3 -I -B "${repo_root}/tools/ntp-workflow-lock.py" --exec bash "$0" "$@"
fi
python3 -I -B "${repo_root}/tools/ntp-workflow-lock.py" \
  --check-inherited "${CR_NTP_WORKFLOW_LOCK_FD}"
evidence_root="${CR_EVIDENCE_DIR:-${repo_root}/docs/evidence/${change_id}}"
action="${1:-}"
timestamp="$(date '+%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%z')"

# Explicitly select the reviewed paired migration; an unset variable keeps
# the existing drop-in-only procedure. Apply approval remains separate.
ntp_mode_args=()
case "${CR_NTP_MIGRATE_MAIN:-0}" in
  0) ;;
  1) ntp_mode_args=(-e '{"cr_ntp_migrate_main":true}') ;;
  *) echo "STOP: CR_NTP_MIGRATE_MAIN must be 0 or 1" >&2; exit 64 ;;
esac

runtime_vars_args=()
runtime_vars_hash=""
if [[ -n "${CR_NTP_RUNTIME_VARS_FILE:-}" ]]; then
  runtime_vars_hash="$(python3 -I -B - "${CR_NTP_RUNTIME_VARS_FILE}" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, os, re, stat, sys
path = sys.argv[1]
info = os.lstat(path)
if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_nlink != 1 or info.st_uid != os.geteuid() or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) & 0o022:
    raise SystemExit('STOP: unsafe runtime variables file')
data = open(path, 'rb').read()
value = json.loads(data)
allowed = {'cr_ntp_migrate_main', 'cr_ntp_source_upstreams', 'cr_ntp_probe_evidence_dir',
           'cr_ntp_probe_run_id', 'cr_ntp_probe_source_head', 'cr_ntp_probe_input_sha256'}
if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != allowed or value['cr_ntp_migrate_main'] is not True:
    raise SystemExit('STOP: runtime variables contain unsupported keys or mode')
if not isinstance(value['cr_ntp_source_upstreams'], list) or not isinstance(value['cr_ntp_probe_evidence_dir'], str):
    raise SystemExit('STOP: malformed runtime variables')
if not os.path.isabs(value['cr_ntp_probe_evidence_dir']):
    raise SystemExit('STOP: probe evidence directory must be absolute')
for key, pattern in [('cr_ntp_probe_run_id', r'[A-Za-z0-9_-]+'),
                     ('cr_ntp_probe_source_head', r'[0-9a-f]{40}'),
                     ('cr_ntp_probe_input_sha256', r'[0-9a-f]{64}')]:
    if not isinstance(value[key], str) or not re.fullmatch(pattern, value[key]):
        raise SystemExit('STOP: malformed runtime binding field: ' + key)
print(hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())
PY
)"
  runtime_vars_args=(-e "@${CR_NTP_RUNTIME_VARS_FILE}")
fi

verify_runtime_vars() {
  if [[ -n "${runtime_vars_hash}" ]]; then
    local current_vars_hash
    current_vars_hash="$(sha256sum -- "${CR_NTP_RUNTIME_VARS_FILE}")"
    test "${current_vars_hash%% *}" = "${runtime_vars_hash}"
  fi
}

test "$(hostnamectl --static)" = "ansible01"
test "$(id -un)" = "server01_ansible"
test -n "${ANSIBLE_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE:-}"
test -r "${ANSIBLE_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE}"
mkdir -p "${evidence_root}"
source_head_file="${evidence_root}/SOURCE_HEAD"
source_invalid_file="${evidence_root}/SOURCE_BINDING_INVALID"

read_bound_source() {
  if [[ ! -f "${source_head_file}" || -L "${source_head_file}" ]]; then
    echo "STOP: evidence has no regular SOURCE_HEAD; preserve it and use a new evidence directory" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  bound_source_head="$(cat "${source_head_file}")"
  if [[ ! "${bound_source_head}" =~ ^([0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$ ]]; then
    echo "STOP: invalid evidence SOURCE_HEAD" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  if [[ -e "${source_invalid_file}" ]]; then
    echo "STOP: source changed during an earlier execution; preserve this evidence for review" >&2
    return 1
  fi
}

require_clean_source() {
  current_source_head="$(git -C "${repo_root}" rev-parse --verify HEAD)" || return 1
  local tracked_status
  tracked_status="$(git -C "${repo_root}" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no --ignore-submodules=none)" || return 1
  if [[ -n "${tracked_status}" ]]; then
    echo "STOP: tracked source has uncommitted changes" >&2
    return 1
  fi
}

bind_source() {
  require_clean_source || return 1
  if [[ ! -e "${source_head_file}" && ! -L "${source_head_file}" ]]; then
    if [[ -n "$(find "${evidence_root}" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ]]; then
      echo "STOP: existing evidence has no SOURCE_HEAD; preserve it and use a new evidence directory" >&2
      return 1
    fi
    # Do not replace a marker written by another invocation.
    (set -o noclobber; printf '%s\n' "${current_source_head}" > "${source_head_file}") || return 1
  fi
  read_bound_source || return 1
  if [[ "${current_source_head}" != "${bound_source_head}" ]]; then
    echo "STOP: this evidence directory belongs to another source HEAD; use a new evidence directory" >&2
    return 1
  fi
}

run_playbook() {
  local label="$1"
  shift
  bind_source || return 1
  verify_runtime_vars || return 1
  local log_file run_rc=0
  log_file="$(mktemp "${evidence_root}/${timestamp}_${label}.XXXXXX.txt")"
  {
    printf 'SOURCE_HEAD=%s\n' "${bound_source_head}"
    ansible-playbook -i "${repo_root}/inventory/hosts.yml" "${ntp_mode_args[@]}" "${runtime_vars_args[@]}" "$@"
  } 2>&1 | tee "${log_file}" || run_rc=$?
  if ! require_clean_source || [[ "${current_source_head}" != "${bound_source_head}" ]]; then
    printf 'STOP: source changed during execution; this evidence requires review\n' \
      | tee -a "${log_file}" > "${source_invalid_file}"
    return 1
  fi
  verify_runtime_vars || return 1
  return "${run_rc}"
}

require_change_approval() {
  test "${CR_CHANGE_APPROVED:-}" = "${change_id}"
}

case "${action}" in
  precheck)
    run_playbook "precheck" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-ntp-01-01-precheck.yml"
    ;;
  source)
    # Must run before `clients` — the client nodes will be refused by
    # control01 (no `allow` yet) until this step has applied.
    require_change_approval
    run_playbook "source_check_diff" --check --diff \
      -e "cr_ntp_change_approved=${change_id}" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-ntp-01-01-apply-source.yml"
    run_playbook "source_apply" \
      -e "cr_ntp_change_approved=${change_id}" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-ntp-01-01-apply-source.yml"
    run_playbook "source_idempotency" --check --diff \
      -e '{"cr_ntp_require_no_change":true}' \
      -e "cr_ntp_change_approved=${change_id}" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-ntp-01-01-apply-source.yml"
    ;;
  clients)
    require_change_approval
    run_playbook "clients_check_diff" --check --diff \
      -e "cr_ntp_change_approved=${change_id}" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-ntp-01-01-apply-clients.yml"
    run_playbook "clients_apply" \
      -e "cr_ntp_change_approved=${change_id}" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-ntp-01-01-apply-clients.yml"
    run_playbook "clients_idempotency" --check --diff \
      -e '{"cr_ntp_require_no_change":true}' \
      -e "cr_ntp_change_approved=${change_id}" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-ntp-01-01-apply-clients.yml"
    ;;
  verify)
    run_playbook "verify_all_nodes" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-ntp-01-01-verify.yml"
    ;;
  rollback)
    require_change_approval
    rollback_host="${2:-}"
    test -n "${rollback_host}"
    run_playbook "rollback_${rollback_host}" \
      -e "cr_ntp_rollback_host=${rollback_host}" \
      -e "cr_ntp_rollback_approved=${change_id}" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-ntp-01-01-rollback.yml"
    ;;
  finalize)
    # Finalization may happen from a later checkout; the observed run owns its HEAD.
    read_bound_source
    {
      echo "# ${change_id} Evidence Index"
      echo
      echo "- Generated: ${timestamp}"
      echo "- Repository: 321Team/infra-ansible"
      echo "- Commit: ${bound_source_head}"
      echo
      echo "## Files"
      find "${evidence_root}" -maxdepth 1 -type f \
        ! -name EVIDENCE_INDEX.md ! -name SHA256SUMS \
        -printf '%f\n' | sort | sed 's/^/- `/' | sed 's/$/`/'
    } > "${evidence_root}/EVIDENCE_INDEX.md"
    (
      cd "${evidence_root}"
      find . -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 \
        | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > SHA256SUMS
      sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS \
        > "${timestamp}_integrity_check.txt"
      find . -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 \
        | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > SHA256SUMS
      sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS
    )
    ;;
  *)
    echo "usage: $0 {precheck|source|clients|verify|rollback HOST|finalize}" >&2
    exit 64
    ;;
esac

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Public CLI fixtures and structured read-only six-node verification."""
import argparse
import datetime
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
from verification_contract import (NODES, ENGINES, capture, clean_environment, completion_play,
                                   context, digest, runtime_command, source_sha, stage, write_json)

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PHASES = ('version', 'runtime', 'cli_guards', 'localhost_tasks', 'readonly_ssh',
          'hardening_check', 'main_precheck', 'dns_verify')


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--python216', type=Path, default=Path('/usr/bin/python3'))
    parser.add_argument('--python221', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--plan', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.plan:
        print(json.dumps({'schema_version': 1, 'engines': ENGINES, 'remote_nodes': NODES,
                          'phases': PHASES, 'collector': 'fds_verification callback',
                          'changes': 'Read-only checks; hardening check mode only. No operational engine switch.'}, indent=2))
        return 0
    out = args.output.resolve()
    if out.is_relative_to(ROOT):
        raise ValueError('Use a new evidence directory outside the source checkout')
    code = source_sha(ROOT)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    env = clean_environment(ROOT, out)
    env['ANSIBLE_STDOUT_CALLBACK'] = 'default'
    rows = []
    expected_steps = [engine + '_' + phase for engine in ENGINES for phase in PHASES]
    started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    run_id = context(code, ENGINES[0], 'run')['run_id']

    def save(final=False):
        source_matches = False
        if final:
            try:
                source_matches = source_sha(ROOT) == code
            except (ValueError, OSError):
                pass
        complete = (final and source_matches and [r['stage_id'] for r in rows] == expected_steps and
                    all(r['status'] == 'PASS' for r in rows))
        write_json(out / 'VERIFICATION_REPORT.json', {'schema_version': 1, 'code_sha': code,
            'run_id': run_id, 'source_verified_after_run': source_matches if final else None,
            'started_at': started, 'expected_nodes': NODES, 'expected_steps': expected_steps,
            'completed': complete, 'overall': 'PASS_READONLY_SCOPE' if complete else 'REVIEW_REQUIRED',
            'operational_upgrade': 'NOT_PERFORMED', 'scope': 'fixtures and six-node read-only checks', 'steps': rows})
        return complete

    def local(name, command, check=None):
        rc, timeout, stdout, stderr = capture(command, ROOT, env, 600)
        (out / (name + '.stdout.log')).write_bytes(stdout)
        (out / (name + '.stderr.log')).write_bytes(stderr)
        passed = rc == 0 and not timeout
        if passed and check is not None:
            try:
                passed = bool(check(stdout))
            except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
                passed = False
        rows.append({**context(code, name.split('_', 1)[0], name, run_id=run_id), 'cli_rc': rc, 'timed_out': timeout,
                     'status': 'PASS' if passed else 'REVIEW_REQUIRED',
                     'origin': {'command': [str(x) for x in command], 'kind': 'public CLI',
                         'artifacts': {name + suffix: digest(out / (name + suffix)) for suffix in ('.stdout.log', '.stderr.log')}}})
        save()
        print(name + ': ' + rows[-1]['status'], flush=True)
        return passed

    def guard_report(path):
        report = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        return report['status'] == 'PASS' and report['outcomes'] == {'PASS': 14, 'FAIL': 0, 'ERROR': 0}

    save()
    key = Path.home() / '.ssh/p1_ansible_ed25519'
    known_hosts = Path.home() / '.ssh/known_hosts'
    if not key.is_file() or not known_hosts.is_file():
        (out / 'prerequisite_error.txt').write_text('Existing SSH key or known_hosts is missing. No SSH attempt.\n', encoding='utf-8')
        return 1
    common_args = ' '.join(['-o BatchMode=yes', '-o PreferredAuthentications=publickey', '-o PasswordAuthentication=no',
        '-o KbdInteractiveAuthentication=no', '-o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes',
        '-o ' + shlex.quote('UserKnownHostsFile=' + str(known_hosts)), '-o IdentitiesOnly=yes', '-o IdentityAgent=none',
        '-o ControlMaster=no', '-o ControlPath=none', '-o ControlPersist=no', '-o ConnectTimeout=10'])
    for label, python in zip(ENGINES, (args.python216.absolute(), args.python221.absolute())):
        executable = python.parent / 'ansible-playbook'
        if not local(label + '_version', [executable, '--version'], lambda raw: b'[core ' + label.encode() + b']' in raw):
            continue
        if not local(label + '_runtime', runtime_command(python, ROOT, label)):
            continue
        generated = out / (label + '_generated')
        summary = out / (label + '_cli_guards.json')
        if not local(label + '_cli_guards', [python, ROOT / 'tests/test-ssh-key-guards.py', '--output', summary,
                     '--export-dir', generated, '--ansible-playbook', executable, '--expect-engine', label],
                     lambda _: guard_report(summary)):
            continue
        if not local(label + '_localhost_tasks', [executable, '-i', 'localhost,', '-c', 'local',
                     '-e', json.dumps({'ansible_python_interpreter': str(python)}), generated / 'regression.yml']):
            continue
        variables = json.loads((generated / 'source-vars.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        variables.update(ssh_guards_file=str(generated / 'ssh-guards.yml'), ansible_ssh_common_args=common_args,
            ansible_connection='ssh', ansible_become=True, ansible_become_method='sudo', ansible_become_user='root',
            ansible_become_flags='-H -S -n', cr_dns_phase='verify')
        execution = generated / 'execution-vars.json'
        write_json(execution, variables)
        prefix = [executable, '-i', ROOT / 'inventory/hosts.yml', '--private-key', key, '-e', '@' + str(execution)]
        for phase, playbook in [('readonly_ssh', 'tests/ssh-server-readonly.yml'),
                                ('hardening_check', 'playbooks/harden_svc_ansible_key.yml'),
                                ('main_precheck', 'playbooks/precheck.yml'),
                                ('dns_verify', 'playbooks/cr-p1-ans-01-01-verify.yml')]:
            name = label + '_' + phase
            metadata = context(code, label, name, run_id=run_id)
            wrapper = generated / (phase + '-scope.json')
            # JSON is valid YAML. The marker is a separate final play for all six nodes.
            write_json(wrapper, [{'import_playbook': str(ROOT / playbook)}, completion_play(metadata)])
            command = prefix + (['--check'] if phase == 'hardening_check' else []) + [wrapper]
            result = stage(command, ROOT, out / name, env, metadata,
                           allowed_changes=(0, 1) if phase == 'hardening_check' else (0,),
                           require_ssh=phase == 'readonly_ssh')
            rows.append(result)
            save()
            print(name + ': ' + result['status'], flush=True)
            if result['status'] != 'PASS':
                break
    return 0 if save(final=True) else 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077

change_id="CR-P1-MON-01-01"
repo_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
evidence_root="${CR_EVIDENCE_DIR:-${repo_root}/docs/evidence/${change_id}}"
action="${1:-}"
timestamp="$(date '+%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%z')"
last_log_file=""

test "$(hostnamectl --static)" = "ansible01"
test "$(id -un)" = "server01_ansible"
test -n "${ANSIBLE_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE:-}"
test -r "${ANSIBLE_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE}"
mkdir -p "${evidence_root}"

run_playbook() {
  local label="$1"
  local target="$2"
  shift 2
  # PID-qualified so two processes invoking the same subcommand within the
  # same wall-clock second (identical $timestamp) never tee to the same
  # path; run_id in the header alone only identifies a log after the fact,
  # it does nothing to stop two processes from colliding on one filename.
  local logfile="${evidence_root}/${timestamp}_$$_${label}.txt"
  local run_sha run_tree input_hash
  run_sha="$(git -C "${repo_root}" rev-parse --verify HEAD)"
  run_tree="clean"
  git -C "${repo_root}" diff --quiet --ignore-submodules HEAD -- || run_tree="dirty"
  input_hash="$(cat "${repo_root}/inventory/hosts.yml" "${repo_root}/inventory/group_vars/all.yml" \
    | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  {
    printf '# run_id=%s_%s commit=%s tree=%s label=%s target=%s input_hash=%s started=%s\n' \
      "${timestamp}" "$$" "${run_sha}" "${run_tree}" "${label}" "${target}" \
      "${input_hash}" "$(date -Iseconds)"
    set +e
    ansible-playbook -i "${repo_root}/inventory/hosts.yml" "$@" 2>&1
    rc=$?
    set -e
    printf '# rc=%s finished=%s\n' "${rc}" "$(date -Iseconds)"
    exit "${rc}"
  } | tee "${logfile}"
  last_log_file="${logfile}"
}

# Fails the run unless every non-localhost PLAY RECAP line in the just-
# produced log shows a true no-op (changed=0, unreachable=0, failed=0), AND
# the set of hosts that actually appear in the recap is exactly the set
# inventory says egress_proxy should contain — not a subset, not a superset,
# not a completely different host. ansible-playbook itself exits 0 for a
# successful run that still changed things (or ran against the wrong hosts),
# so this is the only thing that actually enforces "the second apply ran
# against the right target(s) and was a true no-op" rather than leaving it
# to whoever reads the log afterward. Checking every matching line (not just
# the last) matters once there is more than one real target host: a passing
# recap for the last host must not hide a changed>0 recap for an earlier
# one, and the localhost guard play's own recap (always ok=1 changed=0,
# unrelated to the actual target) is excluded so it can't be mistaken for
# real evidence.
assert_idempotent() {
  local logfile="$1"
  local recap_lines expected_hosts actual_hosts
  recap_lines="$(grep -E '^[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]*: ok=[0-9]+[[:space:]]+changed=[0-9]+[[:space:]]+unreachable=[0-9]+[[:space:]]+failed=[0-9]+' "${logfile}" \
    | grep -v '^localhost[[:space:]]')"
  if [[ -z "${recap_lines}" ]]; then
    echo "IDEMPOTENCY CHECK FAILED: no non-localhost PLAY RECAP line found in ${logfile}" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  if printf '%s\n' "${recap_lines}" | grep -qvE 'changed=0[[:space:]]+unreachable=0[[:space:]]+failed=0'; then
    echo "IDEMPOTENCY CHECK FAILED: one or more target hosts were not a no-op:" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "${recap_lines}" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  expected_hosts="$(ansible-inventory -i "${repo_root}/inventory/hosts.yml" --graph egress_proxy \
    | sed -n 's/^.*--//p' | grep -vE '^@|:$' | sort)"
  actual_hosts="$(printf '%s\n' "${recap_lines}" | awk '{print $1}' | sort)"
  if [[ "${expected_hosts}" != "${actual_hosts}" ]]; then
    echo "IDEMPOTENCY CHECK FAILED: recap host set does not match the egress_proxy inventory:" >&2
    echo "  expected: $(printf '%s' "${expected_hosts}" | tr '\n' ' ')" >&2
    echo "  actual:   $(printf '%s' "${actual_hosts}" | tr '\n' ' ')" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

require_change_approval() {
  test "${CR_CHANGE_APPROVED:-}" = "${change_id}"
}

require_clients_confirmed() {
  test "${CR_PROXY_CLIENTS_CONFIRMED:-}" = "${change_id}"
}

case "${action}" in
  precheck)
    run_playbook "precheck" "egress_proxy" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-mon-01-01-precheck.yml"
    ;;
  apply)
    require_change_approval
    require_clients_confirmed
    run_playbook "apply_check_diff" "egress_proxy" --check --diff \
      -e "cr_mon_change_approved=${change_id}" \
      -e "cr_mon_proxy_clients_confirmed=true" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-mon-01-01-apply.yml"
    run_playbook "apply" "egress_proxy" \
      -e "cr_mon_change_approved=${change_id}" \
      -e "cr_mon_proxy_clients_confirmed=true" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-mon-01-01-apply.yml"
    run_playbook "apply_idempotency" "egress_proxy" \
      -e "cr_mon_change_approved=${change_id}" \
      -e "cr_mon_proxy_clients_confirmed=true" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-mon-01-01-apply.yml"
    assert_idempotent "${last_log_file}"
    ;;
  verify)
    run_playbook "verify" "egress_proxy" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-mon-01-01-verify.yml"
    ;;
  rollback)
    require_change_approval
    run_playbook "rollback" "egress_proxy" \
      -e "cr_mon_rollback_approved=${change_id}" \
      "${repo_root}/playbooks/cr-p1-mon-01-01-rollback.yml"
    ;;
  finalize)
    {
      echo "# ${change_id} Evidence Index"
      echo
      echo "- Generated: ${timestamp}"
      echo "- Repository: 321Team/infra-ansible"
      echo "- Finalize commit: $(git -C "${repo_root}" rev-parse --verify HEAD)"
      echo
      echo "## Files"
      while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        fname="$(basename "${f}")"
        header="$(head -n1 "${f}" 2>/dev/null)"
        footer="$(tail -n2 "${f}" 2>/dev/null)"
        run_id="$(printf '%s' "${header}" | grep -oE 'run_id=[^ ]+' | cut -d= -f2- || true)"
        run_commit="$(printf '%s' "${header}" | grep -oE 'commit=[0-9a-f]+' | cut -d= -f2 || true)"
        run_target="$(printf '%s' "${header}" | grep -oE 'target=[^ ]+' | cut -d= -f2 || true)"
        run_rc="$(printf '%s' "${footer}" | grep -oE '^# rc=[0-9-]+' | tail -n1 | cut -d= -f2 || true)"
        meta=""
        [[ -n "${run_id}" ]] && meta="run_id: ${run_id}"
        [[ -n "${run_target}" ]] && meta="${meta}${meta:+, }target: ${run_target}"
        [[ -n "${run_commit}" ]] && meta="${meta}${meta:+, }commit: ${run_commit}"
        [[ -n "${run_rc}" ]] && meta="${meta}${meta:+, }rc: ${run_rc}"
        if [[ -n "${meta}" ]]; then
          echo "- \`${fname}\` (${meta})"
        else
          echo "- \`${fname}\`"
        fi
      done < <(find "${evidence_root}" -maxdepth 1 -type f \
          ! -name EVIDENCE_INDEX.md ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 | sort -z)
    } > "${evidence_root}/EVIDENCE_INDEX.md"
    (
      cd "${evidence_root}"
      # PID-qualified so two finalize invocations in the same wall-clock
      # second never target the same filename; a shared timestamp name here
      # previously meant the second run's SHA256SUMS listed the first run's
      # already-written integrity report, then truncated that same file via
      # the `>` redirect a moment later, failing its own just-computed hash.
      integrity_report="${timestamp}_$$_integrity_check.txt"
      find . -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 \
        | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > SHA256SUMS
      sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS > "${integrity_report}"
      find . -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 \
        | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > SHA256SUMS
      sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS
    )
    ;;
  *)
    echo "usage: $0 {precheck|apply|verify|rollback|finalize}" >&2
    exit 64
    ;;
esac
